urlText: Route 134 changes
content:
From Monday 20 January 2025, bus route 134 services will change to provide a faster and more direct connection between Sussex Inlet and Sanctuary Point.
 
The revised Route 134 will operate as follows:
  • The bus will continue to start at Berrara and Sussex Inlet.
  • The route will be extended to Huskisson.
  • The service will now travel via Island Point Road through St Georges Basin and Sanctuary Point, then to Vincentia and Huskisson.
  • Route 134 will no longer operate via Tomerong. However, Tomerong will still be connected to Berrara, Sussex Inlet and Nowra by the existing Route 135.
Stops affected
 
The following bus stops in Tomerong will no longer be serviced by the Route 134 bus:
  • Grange Rd at Island Point Rd
  • Hawken Rd before Grange Rd
  • Hawken Rd at McGuire Way
  • Hawken Rd opp Torbin Pl
  • Tomerong Public School, Hawken Rd

In the evening services will continue to run to and from Barangaroo Wharf instead from 7pm to 10pm. Last ferries from Parramatta and Olympic Park to Barangaroo leave at 6.38pm. Last ferry towards Olympic Park leaves Circular Quy at 6:37pm. Last ferry to Parramatta leaves Circular Quay at 6.07pm. Services resume with additional late night ferries from Circular Quay to Olympic Park at 10:07pm and 11:07pm.
